meta.title: Dr Robin Bothra - General and Laparoscopic Surgeon in Jaipur | RNMH
meta.description: Consult Dr Robin Bothra, General and Laparoscopic Surgeon at R N Multispeciality Hospital Jaipur. 15+ years of experience. Book an appointment today.

biography: Dr Robin Bothra specialises in minimally invasive (laparoscopic) and general surgery. His focus includes gallbladder, hernia, appendicitis and trauma surgeries, ensuring faster recovery and minimal scarring. Known for his clear communication, he believes in thoroughly educating patients before any surgical intervention.
clinicalPhilosophy: Every patient deserves compassionate care, clear communication, and the most effective, least invasive treatment plan available.

faqs.answer: You can book an appointment with Dr Robin Bothra by calling our reception or messaging us directly on WhatsApp via this page.
